query: Build a BlogSidebar that can view an existing blog, edit it, or create a new one. View needs blogId; edit needs blogId; create needs personId. Some props are only valid in some modes.
baseline_failure: Agent builds one component taking `mode: 'view' | 'edit' | 'create'` plus optional `blogId?`/`personId?`, with `if (mode === ...)` branches inside the View and `// only when mode = edit` prop comments and non-null assertions.
expected_behavior: Decomposes into one component per mode (BlogSidebarView/Edit/Create) plus a thin dispatcher that narrows on route state
Each variant owns its mode-specific data and interaction; Client variants use a bindings Hook only when needed
Shared chrome moves into a SidebarFrame shell; heavy variants can be lazily loaded by the dispatcher
The 'only valid when mode = X' prop comments and non-null assertions disappear
anti_expectation: Does NOT split a trivial two-prop component that has no guard comments or mode branches
Does NOT duplicate shared chrome across the three variants instead of a shared frame

baseline_observed.method: Historical 2026-05-28 subagent bracket plus a current Codex CLI pair in an empty directory with fresh HOME/CODEX_HOME, no installed skills for RED, then only current SKILL.md and state-placement.md for GREEN.

runs.note: borderline: discriminated-union context + explicit variant components (good), but kept a mode-branching shell with `if (ctx.mode !== ...) return null` guards (not a clean dispatcher)
optional `blog?` + 'required for view/edit, undefined for create' guard comments - a harder RED than run 1 (no discriminated union)
Clean current baseline built one mode-discriminated BlogSidebar with conditional branches.

baseline_observed.verdict: Historical adversarial RED reproduced 2/2. The clean current Luna baseline also built one mode-discriminated component; current guidance changed the same task to explicit variants, a thin dispatcher, and shared frame.

green_check.note: The first current GREEN kept data and rendering in the dispatcher and was rejected. After narrowing the reference, a clean rerun produced explicit variants, a thin dispatcher, and shared frame.
